_comment: ADR-371 vehicle passengers — ride and destination dismount. Tunables only; no gameplay values live in code. dismountSearchRadiusTiles: how far (Chebyshev rings around the vehicle tile) a normal dismount looks for a safe tile before the rider stays seated and retries later. dismountFallbackRadiusTiles: how far a FORCED dismount (vehicle entity gone) looks before giving up and leaving the rider exactly where they already stand — never an unchecked tile. The legacy left-side exit point (beside the vehicle, width/2 + 0.6) is always tried first when it is safe, so the ADR-360 exit spot is unchanged on open ground.
